author: Animalogic
description:
The natural world is full of incredible creatures, but not all of them are still with us. Throughout history, many fascinating animals have quietly disappeared, leaving behind only fossils, historical records, and a few haunting images. Some went extinct centuries ago, while others vanished within the last few decades.

Examining the nature of the beast.

From apex predators to the planet's strangest creatures, Animalogic goes deep into the science, behavior, and biology of the animal kingdom, one species at a time.
